sloka: स्वाशितास्तव मांसेन गृध्रगोमायुवायसाः।भविष्यन्त्यद्य वै पाप तीक्ष्णतुण्डनखाङ्कुराः ।। ६.७९.२० ।।
transliteration: svāśitāstava māṁsena gṛdhragomāyuvāyasāḥ।bhaviṣyantyadya vai pāpa tīkṣṇatuṇḍanakhāṅkurāḥ ।। 6.79.20 ।।

translations.english: "O Sinner! Today vultures, jackals and crows with sharp beaks and goads like claws will also be satiated with your flesh."
